pointers.sentence: That storage is `staticfiles_storage`, which the command takes when it is made: a `ConfiguredStorage`, a `LazyObject` that stands for the storage `storages` makes for the alias `"staticfiles"` (`django/contrib/staticfiles/storage.py:ConfiguredStorage`) ([Lazy objects: `LazyObject` and `SimpleLazyObject`](../utils/lazy-objects.md)).

The collectstatic command sets `BaseCommand.requires_system_checks` to one tag, `Tags.staticfiles`, so `BaseCommand.execute` runs before it only the checks of that tag, in Django `check_finders` and `check_storages`, and no model check can stop it ([Running a command: `BaseCommand`](../commands/running.md), [Finding static files: the finders](static-finders.md)) (`django/contrib/staticfiles/management/commands/collectstatic.py:Command`).

`Command.set_options` takes the patterns of `--ignore` and, unless `--no-default-ignore` is given, adds the `ignore_patterns` of the staticfiles application's config, `StaticFilesConfig` or a project's subclass of it (`django/contrib/staticfiles/management/commands/collectstatic.py:Command.set_options`).
The finders apply them as they list, to a file's name and to its path inside the directory it is listed from (`django/contrib/staticfiles/utils.py:get_files`).

`Command.handle` asks before it collects, unless `--noinput` is given, whenever the destination may hold files. When `Command.is_local_storage` finds a `FileSystemStorage` with a location, the prompt names the directory and is shown only if the directory exists and has something in it; otherwise the command does not look and, its comment says, plays safe and asks. The warning is "This will DELETE ALL FILES in this location!" with `--clear` and "This will overwrite existing files!" without; any answer but "yes" raises `CommandError`, "Collecting static files cancelled." (`django/contrib/staticfiles/management/commands/collectstatic.py:Command.handle`). The harbour office's first run, into an empty directory, asked nothing; a run into the full directory asked.
`Command.collect` does the work and returns five lists, from which `handle` makes the summary (`django/contrib/staticfiles/management/commands/collectstatic.py:Command.collect`).
`Command.local` is false when the storage's `path` raises `NotImplementedError`, as `Storage.path` does (`django/core/files/storage/base.py:Storage.path`).

`Command.copy_file` and `Command.link_file` each begin by asking `Command.delete_file` whether a file already at the destination may stay (`django/contrib/staticfiles/management/commands/collectstatic.py:Command.delete_file`).

Linking makes the directories and puts at the destination a link, made by `os.symlink`, to the source's absolute path (`django/contrib/staticfiles/management/commands/collectstatic.py:Command.copy_file`, `django/contrib/staticfiles/management/commands/collectstatic.py:Command.link_file`).

Linking makes the directories and puts at the destination a link, made by `os.symlink`, to the source's absolute path (`django/contrib/staticfiles/management/commands/collectstatic.py:Command.copy_file`, `django/contrib/staticfiles/management/commands/collectstatic.py:Command.link_file`).

`ManifestStaticFilesStorage` reads each original through its source storage, not the copy, and processes a file whose hashed copy is missing and, every time, each CSS or JavaScript file, whose references it rewrites: twelve on the first run, five on the second (`django/contrib/staticfiles/storage.py:HashedFilesMixin._post_process`) ([Static file storages: `ManifestStaticFilesStorage` and hashed names](static-storage.md)).

The manifest is saved only when the storage's generator runs to its end, which the raise prevented, and `--clear` had deleted the old one: the run left no staticfiles.json (`django/contrib/staticfiles/storage.py:ManifestFilesMixin.post_process`).

At verbosity 1 or more, `handle` returns one line, which `execute` writes: the files deleted, if `--clear` deleted any; the files copied, or "symlinked" with `--link`; "to" the directory, when the prompt could name one; and, each only when not zero, the counts unmodified, post-processed and "skipped due to conflict" (`django/contrib/staticfiles/management/commands/collectstatic.py:Command.handle`).
At verbosity 1, files skipped for a conflict and files deleted by `--clear` appear only as counts in the summary; verbosity 2 names each (`docs/releases/6.0.txt`).

`clear_dir` and `delete_file` only say what they would delete; a copy or a link is announced at verbosity 1 as pretended; and `post_process` is called with `dry_run=True`, on which `HashedFilesMixin.post_process` does nothing and no manifest is saved (`django/contrib/staticfiles/storage.py:HashedFilesMixin.post_process`).
